page.overview:
What is Elrik Vonreg's RK-3 blaster?

A customized red-accented RK-3 blaster was utilized by First Order Major Elrik Vonreg. The pistol was manufactured by Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc. and Sonn-Blas Corporation. In 34 ABY, after the First Order hired pirate Kragan Gorr and his Warbird gang to abduct the pilot Torra Doza, Vonreg employed the weapon to betray the pirates aboard their sail barge, the Galleon. The pilot shot the pirates Drell and Skreek during the blaster fight and retrieved Doza from her captors.

Major Elrik Vonreg's Imperial-era RK-3 blaster was customized and featured a red finish to match his crimson armor. The one-handed weapon featured white indicator lights at the back of the pistol to indicate the weapon's power levels. Vonreg's pistol had pinpoint precision and discharged red blaster bolts.

The blaster was manufactured by Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc. and Sonn-Blas Corporation and was utilized by the First Order Special Forces pilot Elrik Vonreg. the First Order secretly hired the pirate Kragan Gorr and his Warbird gang to abduct the pilot Torra Doza from the Colossus refueling station on the planet Castilon to entice Imanuel Doza—the station's captain and Torra's father—into hiring the First Order to protect the station from raids from the very same pirates. After the Warbirds successfully captured Torra, the pirate leader contacted Commander Pyre of the First Order to inform him of the mission's success. Pyre then arranged for Vonreg to deliver the pirates' payment to their sail barge, the Galleon.

When the major arrived and disembarked from a shuttle, he was welcomed by the pirates Drell, Skreek, and Valik with a captured Doza. Vonreg greeted Gorr before revealing his pistol and opening fire on the Warbirds. The major successfully shot Drell, knocking unconscious, and Skreek, knocking into the ocean of Castilon—though both survived the attack. Vonreg then escorted Doza to the shuttle while continuing to fire at Gorr's pirates. After leaving the skirmish, the shuttle returned to the Colossus station, where Vonreg returned Torra to her father.
